The '''Emorus system''' was a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of [[Emori leatherwork]]<ref name="No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Emori leatherwork]]|system=Emorus [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> and was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Emorus [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-10.<ref name="TEA" />
